title: Paragon Bank provides £3.8m for Bath apartment conversion
summary:
Paragon Bank has completed a £3.8m development finance facility for the conversion of a historic office building in Bath city centre into 15 private apartments. The transaction marks the lender's second deal with ORM Developments, with the scheme carrying an estimated gross development value of approximately £6.2m.

title: Specialist lender approves £160,000 buy-to-let after decline
summary:
Specialist lender Rely has approved a £160,000 buy-to-let mortgage for a first-time landlord purchasing an £865,000 London property, after the application was rejected by another lender. The loan represents a 20% loan-to-value ratio on a property near London Bridge generating £2,000 monthly rental income.

title: Developer secures £1.9m to convert Bath office to flats
summary:
A developer has secured a £1.9m refurbishment bridging loan from Aspen Bridging to convert a Grade I listed office building in Bath city centre into five residential apartments. The financing structure includes an initial advance of £800,000 at 80% loan-to-value, with the remaining £1.1m released through staged development drawdowns.

title: Kent estate agency acquires rival’s lettings portfolio
summary:
Guildcrest Estates has acquired Frederick & Co Property Services, a Thanet-based lettings business, adding approximately 150 managed properties to its portfolio across Kent. The transaction forms part of the independent estate agency's expansion strategy as it grows its property management division.

title: Rightmove launches podcast series for estate agents
summary:
Rightmove has partnered with property industry commentator Silvia Eldawi to launch a podcast series aimed at estate agents across the UK. The podcast features 40 episodes with 10 agency leaders covering topics including sales progression, technology and customer experience.

title: Mid-October deadline looms for pre-Christmas property sales
summary:
Properties must be listed by 16th October to have a realistic chance of securing a sale agreement before Christmas, according to new analysis of UK housing market data. Research shows the current average time from listing to agreed offer stands at 68 days, representing a 10-day increase compared to last year.

title: New landlord database to cost £65 per property annually
summary:
The National Residential Landlords Association has criticised the upcoming private rental database, describing the £65 annual fee per property as disproportionate to the service provided. The database, scheduled for launch in December as part of the Government's Renters' Rights Act, will apply to over five million private sector properties.

title: Green Party proposes three-year rent cap for private sector
summary:
The Green Party has proposed a three-year cap on private rental increases, limiting rises to the lowest of inflation, wage growth or 2%. Industry bodies have criticised the policy, citing evidence from Scotland and international markets that rent controls reduce investment and housing supply.

The post Green Party proposes three-year rent cap for private sector appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Industry body calls for end to local landlord licensing
summary:
Propertymark has called for local landlord licensing schemes to be scrapped once England's national landlord register becomes operational. The trade body argues that current local schemes create unnecessary duplication and impose significant costs on landlords without improving enforcement outcomes.

The post Industry body calls for end to local landlord licensing appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Prime London property prices fall up to 25% from peak
summary:
Property prices in prime central London areas have declined significantly, with some neighbourhoods experiencing drops of more than 25% from their previous peaks. Inner London boroughs recorded an 8.3% price decrease in the year to June, whilst Westminster saw the steepest decline at 25.4% year-on-year.
